Her father is Abderrahmane El Mansouri, who was pasha (deputy governor) of Marrakesh and the ambassador of Morocco to the United Arab Emirates. Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri (born 3 January 1976) is a Moroccan politician and lawyer who is the prime minister–designate of Morocco since 29 September 2026. She is the first woman to hold the office. A member of the Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM), she previously served as mayor of Marrakesh, first from 2009 to 2015, and then since 2021. El Mansouri studied law in France. She joined the PAM in the 2000s and won a seat on the city council in 2009, after which she was selected as mayor of Marrakesh.
